names_for.catalogue_side: Data Marketplace / AI Data Marketplace; listings called Off-The-Shelf (OTS) datasets
names_for.custom_side: Custom Data Sourcing ("Build Custom Datasets"); data collection services

operator_role.note: Macgence is Licensor of record and claims ownership of the data; the catalogue is first-party.

economics_model.note: Macgence owns or compiles the data and sets its own price; no third-party sellers are shown on the marketplace.

who_pays_fee.note: First-party sales only; no intermediary fee between a provider and a buyer.

supply_models.note: partner_licensed rests only on the Data Licensing page (publisher/creator content, LLM-oriented); whether client-commissioned data is resold is unknown.

custody_model.note: Delivered electronically or on tangible media.

transaction_mode.note: No checkout found; listings lead to a request form and terms are negotiated.

public_prices.note: Only 'from $0.10' starting prices with no unit, and a per-seat platform price; no listing shows a price.

licence_model.note: A standard non-exclusive OTS licence is published, but the ToS says each paid dataset gets a separately negotiated licence.

public_listing.note: Listing pages open without login and are in data.macgence.com/sitemap.xml; content is client-rendered.

buyer_vetting.note: The request form requires a company name; no verification step is described.

versioning.note: Listings say datasets are regularly refreshed (macgence-c028); nothing on versions or what past buyers receive.

human_subject_consent_docs.note: Listings depict identifiable people; no consent or release evidence is offered and the licence disclaims all warranties; only a marketing assertion of GDPR/HIPAA compliance.

contributor_pay_model.note: Freelance collection roles are advertised but pay terms are not published.

erasure_after_sale.note: Deletion is required on termination; Macgence may terminate on 60 days' notice.

quality_evidence.note: Macgence is both operator and sole provider; its quality statements are self-asserted with no independent check shown.

Q1.answer: Only the vendor's target sectors (banking, healthcare, retail and others) are published; no buyer names, units bought or volumes.

Q2.answer: Macgence built its own storefront (about 1050 listings) rather than relying on a third-party marketplace; whether it also lists elsewhere could not be checked without search.

Q3.answer: Inventory is presented as Macgence-compiled and owned, made with a network of experts and freelance collectors, plus content licensed from publishers and creators; rights per source are not broken down.

Q5.answer: Macgence is Licensor of record and owner; it indemnifies buyers against IP infringement claims but disclaims all other warranties, including anything on consent.

Q6.answer: Macgence delivers copies to the buyer electronically or on tangible media.

Q7.answer: Listings depict identifiable people with demographic metadata, but no consent evidence is offered for capturer, subject or place; only a marketing claim of GDPR/HIPAA compliance.

Q8.answer: Standard OTS licence is non-exclusive, internal-use, no redistribution, with audit rights and deletion on termination; the ToS allows exclusive licences per negotiated deal. No fingerprinting is described.

Q9.answer: Deals close through contact-sales: a request form on each listing and negotiated terms; Macgence sells its own inventory at its own price.

Q10.answer: A listing is a record with type, media type, volume, format and device; datasets are said to be refreshed but no version or entitlement model is published, and termination ends access with no refund.

Q11.answer: Buyers see a spec sheet and can request a data sample through a form; quality and security claims are self-asserted.

Q12.answer: Ready-made datasets are called Off-The-Shelf (OTS) datasets in the Data Marketplace; bespoke work is Custom Data Sourcing, and listings offer customisation as an upsell.

conflicts.resolution: Both are live primary text. The published OTS licence is non-exclusive, while the ToS says a paid dataset's licence may be exclusive by written agreement; read together, exclusivity is a negotiated override of the standard licence.
The ToS names Macgence Technologies Private Limited; the Data License Agreement names Macgence Technologies (OPC) Private Limited. Company registry records could not be checked without search.
